accumulation.qualification: Illustrative constant uncorrected rate error, not measured H4 performance; known rate correction can remove systematic component.

convention: east-positive; simultaneous local/reference mean solar time, dates and clock error resolved
distanceDecision: Do not narrate or assert a universal distance conversion. Degree separation corresponds to different parallel distances with latitude; no unsupported exact miles conversion is needed.
equationOfTime: E = LAT - LMT; LMT = LAT - E. At apparent local noon LAT=12h, so LMT=12h-E.
